messages:
alex b: Heads-up: nightly perf job shows p99 spike on runtime after today's merge. CI perf job 2026-03-18T02:23Z
maya: saw it too, p99 ~2.8s -> ~4.2s on small-seq workload :grimacing:
samir: which job? link?
alex b: https://ci.internal/redwood/runner/12345 :eyes:
ci-bot: build 12345 — tests complete, perf-nightly: FAIL (p99 regression)
helena: logs show kernel fallback path firing a lot of times, maybe kernel selection changed
alex b: here's quick diff that landed earlier: commit 9f3b2c5 — 'prefer tiled kernel if memory_estimate > threshold'
maya: that change only touched kernel selection heuristics, right? could change fallback logic
samir: trying local repro now with ./scripts/perf_repro.sh --model small --seq 256 --warmups 5 --iters 200
samir: quick log snippet:
```
[perf] p99: 4200ms
[trace] kernel_choice: tiled -> fallback -> generic
[kvcache] hit_rate: 0.12 -> 0.14
```
maya: that fallback -> generic path jumps memory copies and kills batching
alex b: can you run with env PERF_PROFILE=1 and upload prom/async flame?
samir: uploaded: https://artifacts.internal/abc123/profile.svg
helena: flame shows heavy memcpy in generic kernel path and higher mutex contention on batch queue
maya: plan: git-bisect between build 12330 (good) and 12345 (bad). I'll attach bisect script.
alex b: assign to maya, thx
maya: starting bisect now, using bisect script that runs quick mini workload
maya: bisect nailed it down to commit c7a1d1e (kernel selection refactor). stack trace points to new decision logic that ignores per-request seq distribution
samir: confirm locally by reverting that commit; perf back to p99 ~2.7s
helena: good repro. root cause: when batcher sees mixed sequences, new logic prefer tiled kernel for avg-length but falls back when long tail appears, resulting in frequent kernel switches
alex b: mitigation options: revert commit c7a1d1e, or change heuristic to consider quantiles (95th) and avoid toggling within a single batch
maya: I'm preparing a minimal patch to compute seq 95th percentile per batch
maya: quick patch diff attached in PR #987
ops-bot: rollout blocker flag set on release/edge until fix in
alex b: can we hotfix to revert for now? reduces blast radius
samir: +1, PR ready to revert. running CI to validate
samir: CI run 12346 (revert applied) — perf-nightly PASS (p99 ~2.6s)
alex b: great. create postmortem and add test to perf CI covering mixed sequence distributions
maya: will open follow-up to implement quantile-aware heuristic and unit tests
helena: add note to runtime docs about kernel fallback cost
alex b: thanks all — I'll merge revert and unblock rollout. :tada:
